description: This PHP source file generates reports for Baseline Level 1 and 2 results in a testing environment. It includes database queries, report generation logic, spreadsheet creation, and display logic for test metrics, statuses, and statistics within a testing framework.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs email configuration including subject and CC list based on the GUI object's properties.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object structure with test plan, platform, and testing data from the database.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet report with detailed test results, statuses, and statistics, saving it temporarily for download.

methods.name: xlsStepOne
methods.description: Creates the initial header and context information for the spreadsheet report.

methods.name: initLblSpreadsheet
methods.description: Initializes label mappings for spreadsheet column headers.

methods.name: initStyleSpreadsheet
methods.description: Defines styles for spreadsheet cell formatting.

methods.name: setCellRangeSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an array of cell ranges represented by column labels for spreadsheet columns.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing test plan metrics within the database.
